SET cat1 = cat3, cat2 = (SELECT cat1 FROM (SELECT cat1 FROM faturamentos WHERE id = faturamentos.id) AS temp), cat3 = (SELECT cat2 FROM (SELECT cat2 FROM faturamentos WHERE id = faturamentos.id) AS temp)
WHERE empresaSlug = 'barbiero-seraphine' 
AND data BETWEEN '2026-05-22' AND '2026-05-28';
